It might seem like people in tech and investing have lost their minds. And in some sense that is true. But a lot of the behavior is rational in some sense, even if it’s not “honorable” 

Why is it happening now? Yes, some people have AI psychosis. But something deeper is happening 

In life, there are two types of games. Single turn and multi turn games. Single turn, or one-shot, games are just what they sound like. One turn and the game is over. No more turns. 

Multi turn, or sequential, games have multiple turns. Which means history, reputation, and consequences for your actions have a large impact. You expect to see the players on the board multiple times in the future 

Most things in the game of life are multi turn. Careers are long. Investments take time to come to fruition, and you will want to redeploy the capital 

But when the stakes get high enough, people start to squint at the board and see that they can end the game in one turn. Or at least they think they can. 

I’ve talked a lot about how AI is the big one. So it’s not crazy to me that some people are looking at the board and thinking there might be only one turn left, and they are just going for it.

my optimistic take is that the physical consumer product model which is beset by paid subscriptions for features and/or reliance on cloud based services, will collapse within the next 5 years

i mean for stuff like your cars, TVs, thermostats, etc. which are all spying on you and often won't work to their full capability unless you pay every month for some stupid service

two key drivers:

1) AI can be used to trivially root many devices now, and install custom firmware which can do whatever you want. additional AI running on your own hardware could then trivially administer these devices. this is niche nerd stuff right now, but i think won't be for much longer

2) Chinese hardware is gaining ground on old and lazy competition from the US, Japan, and Korea who are now producing shittier and shittier products which rely increasingly on planned obsolescence and selling you on some service/subscription BS. and most of those Chinese hardware producers are wiling to sell the hardware without the subscription because they know no one wants a subscription from them
